name: Ada Kittredge
want: own the best corner in Haddon when the town is real
secret: She has been buying lots through Lyman Pell's inside word on where the depot will stand, and has paid him for it.
description: A widow who follows the railroad with a wagonload of goods and a sharp memory for debts.
appearance: A man's duster over a calico dress, a pencil behind her ear.
